subject: Request: one-off pilot credit addendum & extension — ClearSky Analytics
messages:
From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@clearskyanalytics.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearskyanalytics.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extra credits + pilot extension due to procurement delay

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at ClearSky is excited about the integration potential. We're running into an internal procurement gating issue: our legal & controls signoff is taking longer than anticipated and we need a bit more runway to finish the POC and show the results to the exec committee.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood grant an extension to the standard 30-day PLG pilot to 60 days for this POC?
- Can we get an additional 50,000 token-equivalent of free credits to cover generation costs during the extended window?

We have an RFP and updated procurement timeline attached (ClearSky_RFP.xlsx). We expect a signed PO within 6 weeks but need the pilot to stay live to finish API integration and evals.

Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Olivia Turner
Director of Data Products
ClearSky Analytics

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@clearskyanalytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extra credits + pilot extension due to procurement delay

Olivia — thanks for the context and for sending the RFP.

I quoted your note below for reference. We can absolutely support evaluating this — our priority is to balance giving you enough runway while protecting our unit economics.

Provisional proposal (pending exec approval):
- One-time 30-day extension to the POC start/end window (we can consider 60 days depending on approval).
- One-time grant of 25k token-equivalent credits today to keep the integration moving while we finalize approvals.

To get final signoff I need to escalate this to our Deal Desk / Finance. Laura, Vivek — looping you in. Key context: ClearSky is strategic in the energy analytics vertical and expects to pilot two production workflows if POC succeeds. They indicated a PO within ~6 weeks. I've attached the RFP they shared.

Olivia — can you confirm: 1) is the PO timeline firm-ish (target date), and 2) will there be any required data residency/security constraints beyond our standard PLG agreement?

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@clearskyanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extra credits + pilot extension due to procurement delay

Thanks for the context, Mateo. 

Recommendation from Deal Desk / Sales leadership: we should treat this as a one-off strategic concession with clear guardrails. Suggested terms for exec approval: 
- Grant a one-time extension to 60 days (start +30d standard +30d extension).
- Provide 40,000 token-equivalent credits (midpoint between your provisional 25k and the customer's ask).
- Require a PO or signed SOW within 45 days of the approval, otherwise credits are revoked and usage billed.

Why: ClearSky is a strong fit for a paid pilot in our energy analytics vertical and loss of momentum risks the whole opportunity. Cost impact is modest and reversible with the PO requirement.

I've attached a short SOW draft (SOW-Draft.pdf) we can use to accelerate PO/signing. Vivek — does finance approve the 40k one-off credit under these conditions?

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales — Mid-Market & Strategic
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Ops <finance-ops@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@clearskyanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extra credits + pilot extension due to procurement delay

Approved with conditions.

Decision: One-time 60-day total pilot window and 40,000 token-equivalent credits granted to ClearSky Analytics (deal: CSKY-4829).
Conditions:
1) ClearSky must issue a PO referencing the attached SOW or sign the SOW in DocuSign within 45 calendar days from today.
2) If PO/SOW is not received in that window, the granted credits will be revoked and usage will be billed at standard PLG rates.
3) Track this as an exception in Deal Desk (exception id: EXC-2027-0418-C SKY) and tag the HubSpot record.
4) Credits only valid for US region usage.

Mateo — please update the HubSpot link and send Olivia the SOW + DocuSign link and confirm timelines. Also please add a one-line note in the deal record that this is a one-time concession approved by Finance.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue Operations & Finance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-Draft.pdf
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/tenant/transactions/ABC-987654
